class.name: NNBTFixedResult
class.brief_description: Ticks its child and immediately returns [member fixed_result], ignoring the child's status.
class.description: Ticks its child once and always returns [member fixed_result] right away, even if the child returned [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING]. Use for stubbing branches during prototyping or forcing a specific status on every tick. If you want to wait for a running child to finish before forcing success or failure, use [NNBTSucceeder] or [NNBTFailer] instead.

members.member: Status always returned after ticking the child.
